context: Tests whether the agent correctly sets up Screen Time FamilyControls authorization, FamilyActivityPicker selection, ManagedSettingsStore shielding, and App Group persistence.

checklist.name: FamilyControls Authorization
checklist.description: Requests authorization using AuthorizationCenter.shared.requestAuthorization(for: .individual) before attempting to access Screen Time APIs.

checklist.name: Activity Picker & App Group Persistence
checklist.description: Presents familyActivityPicker in SwiftUI and persists FamilyActivitySelection using PropertyListEncoder into an App Group UserDefaults container.

checklist.name: ManagedSettings Store Shielding
checklist.description: Uses ManagedSettingsStore to assign application and web domain shields based on selected tokens.

checklist.name: Shield Release & Lifecycle
checklist.description: Implements clearAllSettings() on ManagedSettingsStore to cleanly remove active shields when focus concludes.

checklist.name: Entitlement & Privacy Awareness
checklist.description: References the com.apple.developer.family-controls entitlement and notes that ApplicationToken and WebDomainToken are opaque privacy tokens.
